verifierProblems.what: A secret field's value still reaches the read when the UIA bridge drops that field past maxNodes as "offscreen". This cut reason was added by the #1 fix. reading.ts sets unreadAfter only for the cuts "nodes" and "time", or for busy, so the stop-set check never runs for "offscreen". Probe (FakeProvider + real Host, Chrome document, /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Ember-Powered-by-Github-Copilot/9df81ff3-d6fa-5078-ac02-9c8dbaa6cb03/scratchpad/relfix-verify/perception/probes/v2-offscreen-cut.test.ts): Window + Document + 1596 unnamed groups + DataItem 'Card number 4111 1111 1111 1111' + its Text gives 1600 raw nodes, which is the raw cap. The cell's offscreen Edit is then left out with cut ["offscreen"], and read_window lists `table cell "Card number 4111 1111 1111 1111"` with truncated=false. The same page with one visible link after the cell gives cut "nodes" and the name is withheld. Under the cap, it is withheld too. This is the finding's own case: a checkout page scrolled so that the card row sits at the bottom edge, where everything after it in pre-order is offscreen.
verifierProblems.fix: In app/sidecar-host/reading.ts readWindow, also count the bridge's "offscreen" cut: `const unreadAfter = !!snap.busy || (snap.truncated && snap.cut.some(c => c === "nodes" || c === "time" || c === "offscreen"));`. Past the cap, the bridge leaves out only children of the path to the last element it visited, and that is exactly the chain unreadValueNames walks up from the last listed element. Add the probe as a test in test/unit/sidecar-host-offscreen.test.ts (it fails now).

verifierProblems.what: An unnamed offscreen field that only the visible text beside it labels still leaks. tree.ts look mode calls isSecret(name=""), which is false, so the field is not put in `unlisted` at all. Probe /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Ember-Powered-by-Github-Copilot/9df81ff3-d6fa-5078-ac02-9c8dbaa6cb03/scratchpad/relfix-verify/perception/probes/v2-unnamed.test.ts: DataItem 'Card number 4111 1111 1111 1111' holds Text 'Card number' (on screen) and an unnamed offscreen Edit whose value is 4111 1111 1111 1111. The read lists the cell with the number. Named 'Card number', the same field is withheld. Linux covers this case with name_says_secret -> secret_inside -> secret_by_labels (the read's layout).
verifierProblems.fix: In buildNodes look mode, keep unnamed TEXT_ROLES fields as candidates, with their bounds and values. In Secrets.redact, run secretByLayout over the listed labels plus these candidates. Treat the ones it flags like named unlisted secrets: push their values into told/secret and remember them. Add the probe as a test.
